priceSnapshot.note: The breakout held and then extended. Morning published at 84,742.7 and called the 82,099.0 lid broken; six hours later spot is 85,904.7, up 1,162.0 points or 1.37 percent on the handover, and up 5.88 percent against the 24-hour open of 81,137.0. The session since the morning file ran 84,719.5 to 86,351.4 - a 1,631.9-point box, and that high is the highest BTC print since 29 January 2026. The single most important confirmation is a settled candle, not a wick: the 12:00-16:00 UTC four-hour bar CLOSED at 85,931.7, above the 85,631.3 January high, with confirm flag 1. That was the exact on-strength add trigger the morning file pre-committed to. The 17:00 UTC one-hour bar also settled above it at 85,891.6. What is NOT confirmed is that the move can keep this pace: 4H RSI is 82.71 and 1H RSI is 80.51, and the 15-minute MACD histogram has already rolled to minus 110.73.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 83,697.1. The reduce gate trails up from the morning's 82,099.0 because the broken lid is now 3,800 points away and is no longer a live risk level - it is a disaster stop, not a management stop. 83,697.1 is the base the 08:00 UTC breakout candle launched from and it sits just below the rising 1H EMA20 at 83,852.6; a settled hourly close underneath it means the breakout day is being handed back rather than digested. A wick is not enough, as on 19 and 20 September when wicks either side of 82,099.0 resolved the other way.

addIf.confirmation: A pullback into 85,325.2 that HOLDS on a settled 1H close. That number is the high the morning file printed, so it is the shelf the breakout has to defend to stay a breakout; buying a retest of it is a far better entry than buying 86,000.0. The alternative add is on continuation: a settled 4H close above 86,351.4, today's eight-month high, which clears the last measured short-liquidation cluster and leaves nothing structural until 88,857.0.

decisionBox.changed: Position flips from the morning's TAKE_PROFIT to ADD, and the reason is a pre-committed rule firing, not a change of mind. The morning file named two adds: a pullback into 82,099.0-82,600.0, and on strength 'a settled 4H close above 85,631.3'. The pullback never came - the session low was 84,719.5, some 2,100 points above it - but the strength trigger fired cleanly at 16:00 UTC with a settled close of 85,931.7. Honouring a gate you wrote six hours earlier is the process; refusing it because the price is higher than you would like is the discretion that breaks systems. Sizing is deliberately partial, 12 of 42.89 USDT, because 4H RSI at 82.71 is the one fact arguing the other way. The reduce gate trails up 1,598 points from 82,099.0 to 83,697.1; the add gate inverts from a breakout trigger into a retest buy at 85,325.2; invalidation stays at 82,099.0, which is now a thesis-killer rather than a management level.

liquidityMagnet.note: The realized tape and the positioning tape disagree, and the honest answer is that positioning wins. Over the last two hours twenty-eight minutes OKX filled 1,209,863 USD of LONG liquidations against 95,015 USD of shorts - a 12.7-to-1 flush of longs, the exact mirror of the 100-to-1 short squeeze the morning file measured. That is backward-looking: it says the late chasers are already out, not that the move is over. Forward-looking, the long/short ACCOUNT ratio is 0.88 for the 17:00 UTC bucket and has fallen every hour today - 0.93, 0.92, 0.91, 0.91, 0.89, 0.88 - so accounts have been getting SHORTER into a rising market all session. Funding is 0.0000176, essentially flat, so nobody is paying to be long. Open interest is 2,653,274,142 USD, up 5.63 percent from the morning's 2,511,948,278 - leverage is being added into the move, not evicted by it. Short-crowded positioning plus flat funding plus rising open interest is squeeze fuel, and the only forced-buying pockets measured sit at 86,000.0 and 86,250.0, both above spot. The caveat the morning file made still stands and is repeated here: these are realized fills, so the forward magnet above 86,351.4 is unmeasured by this feed.

calibration.rollingRecord: Midday sessions: 52 decisions, 22 wins, 29 losses, plus 10.67 USDT attributed. Wallet round 1, status active, net worth 213.77 USDT at the morning mark of 84,742.7 against a 227.80 endowment.
calibration.note: The morning call splits cleanly into a right read and a wrong trade, and both deserve saying. The read was right: bias bullish at 58 percent, the 82,099.0 lid called as broken, and the reduce gate at 82,099.0 never came close - the session low was 84,719.5, leaving 2,620.5 points of clearance, so priorReduceFired is false. The trade was wrong. Morning took TAKE_PROFIT and trimmed 0.0002 BTC at 84,742.7 to raise cash for a retest of the broken lid. That retest never came; price went straight up and the trim is now 1,162.0 points offside, a foregone 0.232 USDT on that slice. So actingHelped is false, and the specific error is worth naming: the morning file justified the trim on 1H RSI 79.98 being 'the highest reading in a 299-bar series', but RSI is a momentum oscillator, and in the first session of a genuine range break a record RSI is evidence of a trend starting, not of a top. The mitigation is that morning also pre-committed the exact rule that fires this session - a settled 4H close above 85,631.3 - and that discipline is what converts a mistimed trim into a recoverable one rather than a compounding one. This session buys 12 USDT of that back at 85,904.7 and keeps 30.89 in reserve, so the round trip costs about 0.16 USDT for the optionality it bought. Cheap tuition.
